name: Orb · Mosaic
description: An LED tile wall lighting up in flowing blobs, wrapped on the ball: every cell is a bevelled tile that keeps a faint dark presence when unlit, a streaming fbm field decides which tiles light through the stereographic wrap of a rotating dome, and a per-tile hash promotes a reshuffling scattering of lit tiles to fully saturated confetti hues (WebGL). Ported from Orbkit shdr-29 (MIT).
